method: Use original frozen 106 adjusted D signals and compare D 20-session event-day volume ratio to 20-session RTH M5 volume ratio; add earlier (full-day where possible) M5 source daily aggregates and dedupe by maximum bar coverage; never use post-signal time. Distinction is a sensitivity, NOT modification of original frozen DAILY volume gate. Bars 77 rather than 78 and half-day 41/42 retained, not silently repaired.
